title: D&D 2024 Subclass Data Model
description: Schema for D&D 2024 subclass JSON files in data/subclasses/{class}/

name.description: The name of the subclass (e.g., 'Oath of Devotion', 'College of Lore')

class.description: The parent class this subclass belongs to

description.description: A brief description of the subclass theme and abilities

source.description: The source book for this subclass (e.g., 'Player's Handbook 2024')

features_by_level.description: Features gained at specific levels. IMPORTANT: Each level must map to an OBJECT where keys are feature names and values are feature descriptions (NOT an array).

^([1-9]|1[0-9]|20)$.description: An object mapping feature names to their descriptions

oneOf.description: A simple text description of the feature
A complex feature with additional properties

spells.description: For spell-granting features, spells by level

choices.description: For features with one or more choices (see Choice Reference System)

feature_kind.description: Phase 8 (D6-2): structural role of this feature for builder dispatch. Defaults to 'normal' when omitted. Subclass JSONs typically only use 'normal' or 'spellcasting_setup' (for subclasses like Eldritch Knight / Arcane Trickster that grant a Spellcasting feature).

hidden.description: When true, this feature is suppressed from the rendered features list (Phase 8).

pdf_summary.description: Short PDF-style summary that replaces the verbose description when rendering the sheet (Phase 8).

examples.name: College of Lore
examples.description: Bards who seek knowledge and secrets

3.Bonus Proficiencies: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.
3.Cutting Words: Use Reaction to subtract Bardic Inspiration die from enemy rolls.

6.Magical Discoveries: Learn two spells from Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists.

14.Peerless Skill: Add Bardic Inspiration to failed ability checks or attacks.
